mood: bright audit field with one blue wound
material_language: flat digital UI card surface translated into paper-thin plate layers
crisp sans-serif typography reduced to dark illegible slabs
rounded app-icon tiles with soft shadow pressure
thin vector-line provenance links and audit traces
cool gray metadata ticks along a lower edge
lighting: Clean bright scan lighting with almost no theatrical shadow; allow only soft contact shadows under rounded nodes and folded edges so the system has depth without becoming a product shot.
object_inventory: One broad white system field, one off-center folded or cut blue seam, and 6 to 10 smaller source marks distributed as nodes, notches, slabs, ticks, and apertures around it.

Source anchors should appear as visible abstract hit surfaces: charcoal text slabs for tweets/articles, rounded-square icon nodes for GitHub tool assets, thin gray provenance links for decision traces, bottom-edge tick clusters for metrics, and one blue seam for the Semantica/GitHub source. Each mark should feel physically clickable as an aperture or interruption in the plate, not as a card pasted on top.
negative_constraints: no equal-weight grid of source objects
no unrelated replacement image or metaphorical scene when a source image is attached
do not strip handmade details into generic torn-paper ambience
do not fragment the primary source objects until their original silhouettes stop reading
do not replace source candy/wrapper/handwriting cues with unrelated scraps
